feeds.title: Practical Travel Gear
feeds.description: The Practical Travel Gear is one of the most popular travel-gear-only content site on the web, posting a new detailed review each weekday and providing up-to-date relevant information about new arrivals in the Travel Gear Industry. Our experts evaluate gadgets, shoes, clothing, and luggage based on real-world tests in the field.

feeds.title: Her Packing List Blog
feeds.description: If you're an independent and adventurous travel-loving woman, then you'll love it here! Her Packing List takes the stress out of getting ready for a trip. With 200 packing lists to destinations across the globe, hundreds of travel product reviews, and a plethora of packing tips and hacks to get you organized, we really are your one-stop shop for packing smarter and traveling more confidently.

feeds.title: Pack Hacker Blog
feeds.description: We provide practical resources and honest opinions, guiding you towards smarter travel. You can find answers to questions like what to buy, what to ditch, and how to pack it all up.

feeds.title: Eagle Creek » Travel Gear
feeds.description: Our Travel Blog is a place where you can find packing ideas consisting of the right Travel Gear. We offer you advice on packing lists, and product selection guides, and provide you with helpful packing videos. Eagle Creek is an invitation to discover the wonders of humanity and our planet. From city parks to exotic destinations, we take pride in equipping you with versatile gear to take you beyond your fears and outside your comfort zone.

feeds.title: Indie Traveller » Gear Reviews
feeds.description: Marek has been travelling long-term since 2012, having embarked upon a two-month trip to Thailand which spiralled into a two-year trip around the world! On this blog I hope to encourage others to travel more and to travel independently, by sharing real stories and honest advice. I think too much travel information gets glorified by travel guides trying too hard to sell a destination - instead I want to try and give you an honest perspective.

feeds.title: GearJunkie
feeds.description: GearJunkie, launched in 2006, is a top online publication for product reviews and news in the outdoors world. The site contains thousands of pages of content related to gear reviews, news, travel and adventure stories, a video section, photo galleries and giveaway contests.

feeds.title: Tortuga Blog
feeds.description: Tortuga was founded by two childhood best friends Fred and Jeremy. We offer excellent advice on what to bring and how to pack it, gear guides, packing tips, a packing list, and choose the right travel gear. Tortuga's mission is to make travel easier.

feeds.title: TravelFreak » Gear
feeds.description: TravelFreak is an acclaimed adventure travel blog that provides a brief description of which travel gear is apt for certain destinations. My name is Jeremy Scott Foster and I write about how life becomes more convenient while traveling with the proper gear in this segment of the blog.

feeds.title: The Planet D » Travel Gear
feeds.description: A comprehensive collection of travel gear guides, reviews, and packing tips. Hi, we're Dave and Deb, the founders of this award-winning travel blog. Since 2007 we have visited over 115 countries on all 7 continents and have worked hard to become the leading source of detailed city guides, personal travel tips, inspiring stories and so much more.

feeds.title: The Packable Life Blog
feeds.description: Hello, world. I'm Noel Krasomil, the guy behind The Packable Life. I created The Packable Life to inspire others to travel, hike, and blog with purpose - to grow stronger, more focused, and more inspired every day on the road. I want to challenge you to pack lighter, travel longer, hike farther, and blog smarter.
